external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A library member who borrows, renews or reserves books through the library app and uses branch kiosks.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.

external_entities.name: desk staff
external_entities.description: Library desk staff who can extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned by hand.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand
external_entities.notes: Everyone at the desk uses the same shared login; individual staff and branches cannot be identified from the history.

processes.name: library app
processes.description: The app on a member's phone through which members borrow, renew and reserve books and which calls the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API.

processes.name: lending API
processes.description: A REST API that checks loan rules, processes loan and reservation changes, and is the only component described as reading or writing the loans database.
processes.source_excerpt: It's a REST API. JSON in, JSON out.
processes.notes: The sources disagree about exposure: Lending service note says "The lending API is internal-only"; Interview transcript says "The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet." Authentication is not established: Priya says, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."

processes.name: kiosk
processes.description: A self-service branch kiosk where a member scans their library card and books being borrowed or returned, then sends loan and return information to the lending API.
processes.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
processes.notes: The kiosk's direct communications other than what arrives at the API are not known.

data_stores.name: loans database
data_stores.description: The database containing members, loans, reservations, names, email addresses, home addresses and members' full borrowing histories.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database.
data_stores.notes: The earlier statement about two databases was corrected: the databases were merged in the spring and the old reservations database is gone.

data_flows.name: use app
data_flows.description: A member uses the library app to borrow, renew or reserve books.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members borrow, renew and reserve books through the library app on their phones.
data_flows.data_description: Member and book information for borrowing, renewing and reserving

data_flows.name: manage loans
data_flows.description: The library app calls the lending API with member and book or title information for borrowing, renewing and reserving.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app on their phone calls the lending API. It says which book and which member
data_flows.notes: The API authentication is unknown. Priya said, "I think it checks a token the app gets at sign-in, but I'd have to look."
data_flows.data_description: The member, book or title, and requested loan or reservation change

data_flows.name: send loans
data_flows.description: A kiosk sends each scanned loan and return to the lending API.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The kiosks are in every branch and they send each loan and each return to the lending API as it is scanned.
data_flows.data_description: Member card, book, loan and return information

data_flows.name: change loans
data_flows.description: Desk staff use the circulation page served by the lending API to extend loans, clear account blocks and mark books returned by hand.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Desk staff can extend a loan, clear a block on a member's account or mark a book as returned by hand, through a circulation page the lending API serves.
data_flows.notes: The circulation page uses one shared desk login. The password is on a card taped under the desk, and the history cannot identify the individual or branch.

data_flows.name: read-write loans
data_flows.description: The lending API reads and writes the loans database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The API is the only thing that reads or writes it.
data_flows.data_description: Members, loans, reservations and borrowing-history records

trust_boundaries.name: branch network
trust_boundaries.description: The network on which branch kiosks and desk staff work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The kiosks sit on the branch network.

trust_boundaries.name: council data centre
trust_boundaries.description: The council data centre where the lending API and loans database run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The lending API and the loans database run in the council data centre.

trust_boundaries.name: internet
trust_boundaries.description: The network over which phones talk directly to the lending API.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The phones talk straight to the lending API over the internet.
trust_boundaries.notes: This describes how the API is reached, not the placement of the lending API or library app.

assumptions.assumption: The loans database is confidential because it contains names, email addresses, home addresses and full borrowing histories.
assumptions.basis: Interview transcript states: "Names, email addresses, home addresses and every member's full borrowing history live in the loans database."
